guarantees.claim: msg_mask_permuted[i] is always equal to static_mask[RndCnstMsgPerm[i]] for i in 0..MsgWidth-1.

assumptions.claim: RndCnstMsgPerm[i] must be less than the bit-width of static_mask for all i in 0..MsgWidth-1.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds index may cause simulation / synthesis failure or undefined mask bits, compromising the mask value.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment 'Performance enhancement: Use static mask instead of dynamic LFSR' suggests a trade-off that may reduce entropy of the message mask.
uncertain_points.cond: When the mask is intended to provide side-channel or fault-injection protection.
uncertain_points.risk: A static mask creates a predictable pattern, potentially allowing an attacker to undo the mask and recover secret data or weaken differential security.
